page_title: Superhuman: Docs, Mail, and AI That Work Everywhere

sources.entry: Superhuman -Email client designed for Gmail, focusing on speed and productivity with features like AI email prioritization and instant actions #paid

summary.name: Superhuman
summary.one_liner: Superhuman is an AI productivity suite bundling Mail (an email app), Grammarly (AI writing help), Docs (a team doc and workflow tool), and Go (a proactive AI assistant) that works across apps and browser tabs.
use_cases: triaging a busy email inbox quickly
following up on emails on time
proofreading and polishing writing with AI
drafting replies that match personal tone
summary.what_it_does: Superhuman is presented as a suite of four products: Mail, an email app that the page says is designed for speed, with AI prioritization, follow-up reminders, and AI writing in your voice; Grammarly, an AI writing tool that adapts to tone and voice; Docs, a team doc with AI for writing, tracking, and workflows, with AI-native team hubs and connections to 800+ tools; and Go, a proactive assistant that connects to apps like Gmail, Drive, and Jira and can schedule meetings from within a conversation. The page says the AI works across apps and tabs rather than in one place. It names compatibility with Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
notable: Bundles Mail, Grammarly, Docs, and Go into one suite
Go assistant works across apps and can schedule meetings inside chats
Connects to 800+ tools according to the page
Works with Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor
caveats: Listing tags it as #paid; the page itself shows only a 'Get Superhuman' call to action with no prices
Platform support beyond the web is not stated on the page
Claims such as saving 4 hours per week are marketing statements, not verified
